messages:
maria (Marketing): Uploaded draft to the shared doc — angle = technical playbook + customer impact. link: https://docs.example.com/d/optimize-launch-draft
sam (Growth): Nice framing. can we add a short paragraph on expected inbound volume and lead scoring implications? even a ballpark number helps ops.
leo (Product): will add 99th/median latency and per-request cost. expecting to push our recommended config numbers by EOD.
natalie (Content): intro feels long. can we tighten to ~60 words and lead with the customer value? i'll propose a shorter opening sentence.
maria (Marketing): done — trimmed intro and pushed a revision.
ellen (Sales): when this goes live, sales needs a HubSpot routing map + a standardized lead tag (so reps can filter quickly). can we align on utm and a lead property?
sam (Growth): suggested UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=playbook; lead property: launch_source = "optimize_blog"
leo (Product): added bench numbers to the doc: p50 = 24ms, p95 = 78ms, p99 = 130ms; cost ~ $0.0018 per 1k tokens on the recommended config. mark as "internal benchmark (typical workload)".
maria (Marketing): i'll attribute the numbers as internal. thanks.
ops-bot: provisional webinar created for 2026-05-14T17:00Z — booking link: https://cal.example/w/abc123
ellen (Sales): planning idea: run a short technical webinar the week after publish, sales to co-host two partner seats. will need one-slide checklist for reps.
natalie (Content): proposed post structure: 1) problem statement, 2) technical playbook (routing/caching/quant), 3) benchmarks, 4) quickstart snippet, 5) gated playbook CTA -> webinar signup. should we add a downloadable PDF playbook?
sam (Growth): yes — gated PDF for MQL capture. when someone downloads, set Lifecycle Stage = marketing qualified and add tag launch_source=optimize_blog.
maria (Marketing): implementing a tiny form that POSTs to our webhook. devs, sample payload below — confirm fields: 
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "utm_campaign": "optimize_launch",
  "lead_tag": "optimize_blog",
  "model_profile": "{{model_profile}}"
}
```
leo (Product): add model_profile param — good call. that'll help correlate which benchmark they read.
ellen (Sales): sales kit asks: include one-slide "winner's checklist" with vertical signals, ideal company size, expected CAC range, and next-step play.
maria (Marketing): added a draft sales-kit slide to /ops/sales-kit. i'll ping sales when copy is locked. :thumbsup:
sam (Growth): timeline check — lock copy by Thursday, assets by Friday, publish Tuesday. everyone ok?
leo (Product): good for product.
natalie (Content): i can finalize edits Thursday morning.
ellen (Sales): good from sales.
ops-bot: reminder set: copy-lock review in #marketing on 2026-04-16T15:00Z.
maria (Marketing): thanks all — updating the doc and will post final when copy-locked.
